parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: PACK lists content packs; LEXEME lists word-master rows; ITEM lists row-level question/example/grammar/passage/exercise/dictation/shadowing rows (contentCode=item:{itemId}, full record in item).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Headword substring match; only applies with kind=LEXEME.

parameters.name: cefr
parameters.description: CEFR filter; only applies with kind=LEXEME.

parameters.name: availability
parameters.description: Lexeme lifecycle filter; only applies with kind=LEXEME.

parameters.name: packCode
parameters.description: Vocabulary pack scope; only applies with kind=LEXEME. Defaults to the single-tenant Phase 1 pack. Naming convention VOCAB-{LANG}-PHASE1 (e.g. VOCAB-FR-PHASE1, VOCAB-DE-PHASE1).

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Lexeme language ribbon filter (BCP-47, e.g. en-US, fr-FR); only applies with kind=LEXEME. Omit for all languages.

parameters.name: itemKind
parameters.description: Item kind filter; only applies with kind=ITEM.

x-contract.dualReview: REVIEW_FIRST and REVIEW_FINAL require distinct verified actors; author cannot review own version

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: same actor, target and request hash returns original command result

202.description: Command accepted for content-service application and Outbox publication

post.description: LEXEME_* commands manage row-level word master under a vocabulary pack (contentCode, kind VOCABULARY). The pack is auto-provisioned on first LEXEME_UPSERT. Author cannot self-review (FIRST/FINAL must differ); PUBLISH/UNPUBLISH/ARCHIVE require reasonCode for audit. Pronunciation rows reference media-service assets by id; audio bytes never flow through content-service.

B9ScheduledPublishTaskQuery.name: view
B9ScheduledPublishTaskQuery.description: 只读任务视图；CURRENT 返回当前任务状态，WITH_RECOVERY 仅在服务端已有恢复关联时返回恢复引用。

B9ContentVersionSummary.description: 内容版本的只读摘要。canonical 持久状态只有 DRAFT、IN_REVIEW、APPROVED、PUBLISHED、ARCHIVED；UNPUBLISHED 和 ROLLED_BACK 仅为旧 v1 响应的 deprecated compatibility aliases，新实现不得产生。

status.description: UNPUBLISHED/ROLLED_BACK 仅用于读取旧 v1 数据，新实现不得产生。

licenseCode.description: Admin-only reference; public projections expose only a rights status.

stimulusRef.description: Opaque reference to a content stimulus; answer material is not carried here.

definition.description: Service-owned structured definition. Public projection is generated by an allow-list, never by copying this object.

answerRuleVersion.description: Opaque internal version used only by assessment-service; never emitted in public or learner projections.

B9PublishScheduleInput.description: 排期发布的乐观绑定快照。客户端只能提交版本、校验报告、双审记录和版权快照的引用及版本；content-service 必须在接收时和到期执行时重新核对 owner facts，绑定字段本身不是授权或运行时事实。

B9ScheduledPublishTask.description: 服务端只读的排期发布任务。客户端不能提交、伪造或推进 status，也不能把任务状态当作运行时发布证明；处理、重试、失败和恢复沿用 M1-007 recovery 契约，不在 B9 复制第二套处理状态机。

requestId.description: 创建或幂等重放该任务的服务端 request correlation ID；客户端不能伪造。

traceId.description: 贯穿命令受理、排期执行和审计记录的服务端 trace correlation ID；客户端不能伪造。

recoveryTaskId.description: 仅为服务端已创建的 workflow 恢复引用；不表示恢复已执行或运行时成功。

B9ScheduledPublishTaskRef.description: 命令受理或后台状态中的排期任务只读引用。处理、重试和失败恢复由 M1-007 recovery 负责，不在此引用复制第二套状态机。

B9ContentCommandRequest.description: 命令只表达意图和资源版本；actor、tenant、owner、role、permission、reviewer 和版权事实均由服务端从已验证上下文与内容记录派生。

lexemeId.description: Target lexeme for LEXEME_* commands except LEXEME_UPSERT creation

itemId.description: Target item for ITEM_* commands except creation

targetType.description: Schedule target selector; PACK publishes the latest APPROVED pack version, LEXEME/ITEM publish the pinned row.

targetRef.description: Lexeme/item id for LEXEME/ITEM targets; defaults to contentCode for PACK.

cohort.description: Gray cohort label recorded on the schedule task and its execution receipt. Learner-side enforcement arrives in B4; until then the label is metadata, never a distribution Gate.

B9ContentCommandAccepted.description: 服务端生成的命令受理结果。排期命令只返回只读任务引用；任务 status 不是 runtime publication proof。

outboxEventId.description: Content-service Outbox event identity; publication is at-least-once and consumers deduplicate.

scheduledPublishTask.description: 仅 SCHEDULE_PUBLISH 或其幂等重放结果携带；CANCEL_SCHEDULED_PUBLISH 返回被取消任务的只读引用。

availability.description: 公开投影只返回已发布版本；投影落后或重建期间通过 projectionStatus 表达，不降级为空列表或草稿。

projectionStatus.description: CURRENT 表示 watermark 已追上；STALE/PROCESSING 表示公开投影暂时落后或重建中，content-service 仍不得返回草稿。

B9LearnerContentProjection.x-field-filtering: LEARNER_V1 is PUBLIC_V1 plus server-computed access flags; no content answer rules

projectionStatus.description: 学习投影沿用公开已发布版本；STALE/PROCESSING 只说明 projection watermark，不泄露草稿或答案规则。

sessionPin.description: 已开始学习 session 的服务端版本 pin；缺失表示当前 session 尚未建立 pin。建立后不得静默切换到其他版本。

B9SessionContentPin.description: 学习 session 对内容版本的服务端固定关系。仅表达版本引用和可用性，不返回已移除内容正文、答案或版权证据；UNAVAILABLE 时客户端不得静默回退到其他版本。

B9PublicProjectionState.description: 公开投影水位状态。STALE/PROCESSING 只表示投影落后或重建中，不能把草稿或未授权版本标成 PUBLISHED。

B9AdminContentState.description: 内容后台状态。canonical 持久状态为 DRAFT/IN_REVIEW/APPROVED/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED；旧 UNPUBLISHED/ROLLED_BACK 只读兼容且新实现不得产生。排期任务由服务端只读维护。

authorSubject.description: 仅向具备审核权限的后台投影提供；服务端仍必须独立拒绝作者自审。

latestStatus.description: UNPUBLISHED/ROLLED_BACK 仅为旧 v1 读取兼容值，新实现不得产生。

reviewRecords.description: 按 reviewStage 键控且物理顺序无语义的只读审核记录集合。空集合表示尚未审核；单条只能是 FIRST_REVIEW；双条必须各含一条 FIRST_REVIEW 与 FINAL_REVIEW。每条记录绑定不可变 contentVersionId/contentHash，FINAL_REVIEW 必须基于同一版本与哈希的 FIRST_REVIEW APPROVED。

scheduledPublishTask.description: 若存在待执行排期则返回只读任务引用；不会改变 publicProjection.availability。

lexeme.description: Present only on kind=LEXEME rows: the full word-master record with pronunciations.

item.description: Present only on kind=ITEM rows: the full row-level item record.

scheduledTasks.description: Scheduled publish tasks for this pack (SCHEDULED/CANCELLED/EXECUTED/FAILED).

answerRuleVersion.description: Opaque version identifier only; no answer rule body is returned.

LexemeSense.description: One word sense. At least one of meaningCn (legacy Chinese gloss, retained for compatibility) or meaningLocal (generic local-language gloss) is required; server-side validation rejects a sense carrying neither.

pos.description: Sense-level part of speech; B4 long forms accepted alongside historical abbreviations.

meaningCn.description: Legacy Chinese gloss slot. Retained for compatibility; new non-Chinese languages use meaningLocal.

meaningLocal.description: Generic local-language gloss slot (B4 multilingual ribbon). Carries the sense gloss in the lexeme language (e.g. French sens for fr-FR rows).

accent.description: Open accent tag (BCP-47 style, uppercase-normalized server-side). US/UK/SLOW remain the conventional English values; other languages register their own tags (e.g. FR-PARIS).

audioAssetId.description: media-service asset reference; bytes never flow through content-service

accent.description: Open accent tag (BCP-47 style, uppercase-normalized server-side). US/UK/SLOW remain the conventional English values.

LexemeUpsertInput.description: Row-level word master. Lexemes live under a vocabulary pack (contentCode, kind VOCABULARY); the pack is auto-provisioned on first LEXEME_UPSERT.

lexemeId.description: Omit to create; server derives lx_{headword} sequence

language.description: Lexeme language ribbon (BCP-47, e.g. en-US, fr-FR, de-DE). Omit to inherit en-US; legacy rows without a language read back as en-US. Vocabulary packs follow VOCAB-{LANG}-PHASE1 (e.g. VOCAB-FR-PHASE1).

items.description: Word-level part of speech. PRON/PREP/CONJ/INTERJ are the historical abbreviations (retained for compatibility); PRONOUN/PREPOSITION/CONJUNCTION/INTERJECTION are the converged long forms (B4).

phoneticUS.description: Legacy English-only phonetic slot. Retained for compatibility; new languages use pronunciation rows.

phoneticUK.description: Legacy English-only phonetic slot. Retained for compatibility; new languages use pronunciation rows.

gender.description: Grammatical gender (B4 morphology ribbon). Required for fr-* NOUN rows; French uses MASCULINE/FEMININE.

number.description: Grammatical number (B4 morphology ribbon). Required for fr-* NOUN rows (citation SINGULAR unless the lemma is plural-only).

grammaticalCase.description: Grammatical case (B4 morphology ribbon). French rows omit it; German nouns carry it when declined.

verbGroup.description: Conjugation class, e.g. FR-ER, FR-IR, FR-RE, FR-IRREGULAR.

conjugation.description: Verb conjugation class (B4 morphology ribbon). Required for fr-* VERB rows.

language.description: Lexeme language ribbon (BCP-47). Legacy rows without a language read back as en-US.

phoneticUS.description: Legacy English-only phonetic slot. Retained for compatibility; new languages use pronunciation rows.

phoneticUK.description: Legacy English-only phonetic slot. Retained for compatibility; new languages use pronunciation rows.

conjugation.description: Verb conjugation class (B4 morphology ribbon: verbGroup, irregular).

publishedFields.description: Last published fields snapshot; null when never published. The admin diff compares fields against this snapshot.

ContentItemUpsertInput.description: Row-level content item (question/example/grammar/passage/exercise/dictation/shadowing) under a pack. Rich configuration travels in fields and never requires DDL.

itemId.description: Omit to create; server derives it: prefix by kind

kind.description: DICTATION (listening dictation) and SHADOWING (speaking shadowing) are the B4 multilingual interaction kinds; both run the standard draft/review/publish lifecycle.

stem.description: Question stem / example sentence / grammar title / passage heading

fields.description: Extensible item configuration: options, answerRuleVersion, explanation, cefr, difficulty, audioAssetId, subtitle lines, tags.

kind.description: Row kind; DICTATION/SHADOWING are the B4 interaction kinds.
